synopsis: Chapter 5 cites academic Unreal Engine 4 and Unity work as off-road evidence for using ready-made asset libraries [f4268]. The UE4 examples include academic work using CGTrader assets [f3833]. Chapter 11 reports that CARLA switched from UE4 to UE5 and that some CARLA APIs are unsupported, creating a compatibility caveat when planning around the cited UE4 examples [f8892, f4268].
